name: Derek Miller
title: Policy Analyst and Builder
bio: Derek believes in government and policy that put people first. He backs regenerative business: firms that give back more than they take. That way, people and society can flourish for generations to come.

principles.name: Plain language
principles.text: Written so an eighth grader can follow it. No jargon left unexplained.

principles.name: Show the source
principles.text: Every summary links to the official record it came from.

principles.name: Show the cost
principles.text: Where a number exists, it's on the page, along with who calculated it.
